description: This Java source file defines the JobServices class, which provides static methods for managing background job operations such as canceling jobs, retrying cancellations, purging old jobs, and resetting jobs within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JobServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing background jobs such as canceling, retrying, purging, and resetting jobs within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job identified by jobId, updates its status and cancel timestamp, and returns the result.

methods.name: cancelJobRetries
methods.description: Resets the maximum retry count for a specified job, with permission check.

methods.name: purgeOldJobs
methods.description: Deletes jobs older than a specified number of days from a specified thread pool.

methods.name: resetJob
methods.description: Resets the status and timestamps of a specified job to pending state.
